mapper.select: /* ComponentAuthMapper.selectComponentAuthList 프로그램의 사용 중인 컴포넌트별로 사용자의 권한여부를 조회 (적용기간 내 권한그룹 또는 사용자 권한 중 하나라도 Y 이면 Y) */ SELECT C.CMPN_ID, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USR_CMPN_R U WHERE U.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND U.PRGM_ID = C.PRGM_ID AND U.CMPN_ID = C.CMPN_ID AND U.AUTH_YN = 'Y') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USR_AUTH_GRP_R R JOIN TB_AUTH_GRP_M G ON G.USR_GRP_CD = R.USR_GRP_CD JOIN TB_AUTH_GRP_CMPN_R A ON A.USR_GRP_CD = R.USR_GRP_CD WHERE R.USR_ID = #{usrId} AND A.PRGM_ID = C.PRGM_ID AND A.CMPN_ID = C.CMPN_ID AND A.AUTH_YN = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS AUTH_YN FROM TB_PRGM_CMPN_M C WHERE C.PRGM_ID = #{prgmId} AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.ALIN_SEQ NULLS LAST, C.CMPN_ID
